CancelServiceUsage.description_zh: 当前用户取消对某个服务的使用申请

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Changes the resource group for a cloud resource
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 通过云资源的资源 ID修改云资源所属的资源组

CheckServiceDeployable.description_en: Performs a precheck to verify that a service instance can be deployed
CheckServiceDeployable.description_zh: 服务实例部署前的预检查

ContinueDeployServiceInstance.description_en: If a service instance fails to deploy, you can call the ContinueDeployServiceInstance operation to resume the deployment
ContinueDeployServiceInstance.description_zh: 服务实例部署失败后，调用ContinueDeployServiceInstance继续部署该服务实例

CreateBackup.description_en: Creates a backup for a Compute Nest service instance

CreateServiceInstance.description_en: Creates and deploys a service instance in Compute Nest by specifying parameters such as a region ID, a service instance name, and a service ID
CreateServiceInstance.description_zh: 通过配置地域ID、服务实例名称、服务 ID等参数，在计算巢中创建并部署服务实例

CreateSkillFileDetect.description_en: Creates a Skill file detection task

DeleteBackup.description_en: Deletes a Compute Nest instance backup

DeleteServiceInstances.description_en: Deletes the specified service instances in a region
DeleteServiceInstances.description_zh: 通过地域ID、服务实例ID，精确删除对应的服务实例

DeployServiceInstance.description_zh: 部署已创建的服务实例

GenerateServicePolicy.description_en: Queries the missing access policies before creating a service instance
GenerateServicePolicy.description_zh: 创建服务实例前查询缺少的权限策略

GetBackup.description_en: Retrieves the details of a backup

GetNetworkAvailableZones.description_en: Returns a list of available zones for a specified region
GetNetworkAvailableZones.description_zh: 根据指定的地域获取可用区列表

GetService.description_en: Retrieves the details of a specified service
GetService.description_zh: 查询指定服务的详细信息

GetServiceEstimateCost.description_en: Queries the estimated cost of creating a service instance
GetServiceEstimateCost.description_zh: 查询创建服务实例的预估价格

GetServiceInstance.description_en: Queries the details of a service instance by its region ID, service instance ID, or Alibaba Cloud Marketplace instance ID. The returned information includes the service status, template name, and a list of resources
GetServiceInstance.description_zh: 通过地域ID、服务实例iD或者云市场实例ID、查询服务实例的详细信息，例如服务状态、模板名称、资源列表等信息

GetServiceInstanceSubscriptionEstimateCo.description_en: Queries the estimated renewal cost of subscription resources in a privately deployed service instance. You can query the cost for all resources associated with a service instance ID, or for a specific set of resources
GetServiceInstanceSubscriptionEstimateCo.description_zh: 私有化部署服务实例预付费资源询价。目前支持续费询价，支持对指定服务实例ID下的全部预付费资源统一进行续费询价，或者对指定资源进行续费询价，两种方式只能使用一种

GetServiceProvisions.description_en: Retrieves the provisions of a service, such as its activation status and service roles
GetServiceProvisions.description_zh: 获取服务开通状态、服务角色等预置信息

GetServiceTemplateParameterConstraints.description_en: Queries the parameter constraints for a Resource Orchestration Service (ROS) template in a specified region using the template name and service ID
GetServiceTemplateParameterConstraints.description_zh: 通过模板名称、服务 ID查询指定地域下的ROS模板参数限定值

GetSkill.description_en: Queries the details of a Skill

GetSkillFileDetectResult.description_en: Retrieves the result of a Skill file detection task

GetSkillSpace.description_en: Queries the details of a SkillSpace

GetUserInformation.description_zh: 调用GetUserInformation查询用户相关信息

ListBackups.description_en: Queries a list of backups for Compute Nest service instances
ListBackups.description_zh: 列表查询计算巢实例备份

ListPolicies.description_en: Retrieves a list of access policies
ListPolicies.description_zh: 用户查询权限列表接口

ListPublicSkills.description_en: Queries the list of public skills
ListPublicSkills.description_zh: 查询公开 Skill 列表

ListRestoreTasks.description_en: Queries a list of restore jobs

ListServiceInstanceBill.description_en: Call the ListServiceInstanceBill operation to query bills for service instances
ListServiceInstanceBill.description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceBill查询服务实例账单

ListServiceInstanceLogs.description_en: Retrieves the deployment and upgrade logs of a service instance
ListServiceInstanceLogs.description_zh: 通过地域 ID、服务实例 ID等参数查询服务实例的部署和升级日志

ListServiceInstanceResources.description_en: Queries the resources of a service instance based on parameters such as the service instance ID, Alibaba Cloud Resource Name (ARN), and region ID
ListServiceInstanceResources.description_zh: 通过服务实例 ID、资源 ARN（Aliyun Resource Name）、地域 ID等参数，查询满足条件服务实例资源列表

ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory.description_en: You can call ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory to query the upgrade history of a service instance
ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory.description_zh: 调用ListServiceInstanceUpgradeHistory查询服务实例升级信息

ListServiceInstances.description_en: Queries service instances for your account in a specified region
ListServiceInstances.description_zh: 通过地域 ID，资源ID等参数，查询当前账号在某地域下所有服务实例列表

ListServiceUsages.description_zh: 查看用户自己当前的服务使用申请

ListSkillFiles.description_en: Retrieves the list of skill files
ListSkillFiles.description_zh: 获取 Skill 文件列表

ListTagKeys.description_en: This operation lists existing tag keys

ListTagResources.description_en: Queries a list of tagged resources

ListTagValues.description_en: Lists the tag values for a specified tag key
ListTagValues.description_zh: 查询标签键对应的标签值

RenewServiceInstanceResources.description_en: Renews the subscription resources for a private deployment service instance. This operation supports two renewal methods: renewing all subscription resources for a service instance or renewing only specific resources. You can use only one method per request
RenewServiceInstanceResources.description_zh: 为私有化部署服务实例包含的预付费资源续费。支持对指定服务实例ID下的全部预付费资源统一进行续费，也可以对指定资源进行续费，两种续费方式只能使用一种

RestartServiceInstance.description_en: Restarts a service instance in the Deployed state
RestartServiceInstance.description_zh: 当服务实例状态为Deployed（已部署）时，调用RestartServiceInstance接口重启服务实例

RollbackServiceInstance.description_en: Rolls back an upgraded service instance
RollbackServiceInstance.description_zh: 回滚已升级的服务实例版本

StartServiceInstance.description_en: Call the StartServiceInstance operation to start a service instance that is in the Stopped or StartFailed state
StartServiceInstance.description_zh: 当服务实例状态为Stopped（已关机）、StartFailed（开机失败）时，调用StartServiceInstance接口启动服务实例

StopServiceInstance.description_en: Call the StopServiceInstance operation to shut down a service instance that is in the Deployed or StopFailed state
StopServiceInstance.description_zh: 当服务实例状态为Deployed（已部署）、StopFailed（关机失败）时，调用StopServiceInstance接口关闭服务实例

TagResources.description_en: You can call TagResources to create and attach tags to multiple resources
TagResources.description_zh: 调用TagResources为资源列表统一创建并绑定标签

UnTagResources.description_zh: 调用UntagResources为指定的资源列表统一解绑标签

UpdateServiceInstanceAttributes.description_en: Updates the attributes of a service instance

UpdateServiceInstanceSpec.description_en: You can call the UpdateServiceInstanceSpec operation to upgrade or downgrade a service instance if its parameters or package settings do not meet your requirements
UpdateServiceInstanceSpec.description_zh: 当服务实例的参数值或套餐设置不满足您的要求时，调用UpdateServiceInstanceSpec对服务实例执行变配操作

UpdateServiceUsage.description_en: Updates the information about a service usage request
UpdateServiceUsage.description_zh: 用户更新使用服务申请

UpdateUserInformation.description_en: The UpdateUserInformation operation updates user information

UpgradeServiceInstance.description_en: Upgrades a service instance to a new version

ValidateServiceInstanceName.description_en: Validates the name of a service instance
